title: K. Keep Calm And Carry Off

legend: Petra is learning how to add two positive integers in school, but thinks it is a bit too difficult. They are currently working with the standard algorithm for addition, where you first compute the sum of the two units digits, then the sum of the two tens digits, and so on. Whenever the sum of the digits at the same position in the two numbers exceeds 9, a carry digit is added onto the digit of the next higher magnitude. Petra has trouble with the last step – she often forgets to keep track of the carry digit.

A few weeks ago, she also learnt a simpler method of addition. In this method, you repeatedly add 1$$$1$$$ to one of the numbers and subtract 1$$$1$$$ from the other, until the second one reaches zero. This can of course take a lot of time for large numbers.

Petra now wants to combine the two methods, for fast and error-free addition. Her plan is to first perform the second method one step at a time, until the two numbers would not produce a carry digit when added using the standard algorithm (for positive integers, this always happens eventually). To evaluate the performance of her new method, she has asked you to help her compute the number of steps she must perform of the second method when adding two given integers. Petra may perform the addition by 1$$$1$$$ to either of the two numbers (and subtraction by 1$$$1$$$ from the other).
input: The input consists of two lines, each containing a positive integer with at most 106$$$10^6$$$ digits. These are the two integers Petra wants to add.
output: Output a single integer, the minimum number of times Petra must add 1$$$1$$$ to one of her numbers (while subtracting 1$$$1$$$ from the other) until they can be added using the standard addition algorithm without any carry digits.

legend.ai: Petra 正在学校学习如何将两个正整数相加，但她觉得这有点太难了。她目前学习的是加法的标准算法：先计算两个数的个位之和，然后计算十位之和，依此类推。每当两个数在同一位上的数字之和超过 9 时，就要将一个进位数字加到更高一位的数字上。Petra 在最后一步上遇到了困难——她经常忘记记录进位数字。
几周前，她还学会了一种更简单的加法方法。在这种方法中，你反复将 1$$$1$$$ 加到其中一个数上，并从另一个数中减去 1$$$1$$$，直到后一个数变为 0。当然，对于较大的数，这可能需要很长时间。
现在，Petra 想要结合这两种方法，以便快速且无误地完成加法。她的计划是先一步一步地执行第二种方法，直到使用标准算法将这两个数相加时不会产生进位数字为止(对于正整数，这最终总会发生)。为了评估她的新方法的性能，她请你帮忙计算将两个给定整数相加时，她需要执行第二种方法的步数。Petra 可以选择将 1$$$1$$$ 加到两个数中的任意一个上(并从另一个数中减去 1$$$1$$$)。

input.ai: 输入包含两行，每行包含一个最多有 106$$$10^6$$$ 位的正整数。这两个整数就是 Petra 想要相加的数。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示 Petra 必须将 1$$$1$$$ 加到其中一个数上(同时从另一个数中减去 1$$$1$$$)，直到可以使用标准加法算法将两个数相加且不产生任何进位数字为止的最少次数。
